toolset: The .NET SDK host (dotnet msbuild). Counts depend on this: severity comes from MediaPortal\.editorconfig, but the inventory also depends on which target frameworks the host builds and analyses, so it is NOT comparable with a full Visual Studio MSBuild log (that host sees fewer target frameworks and applies its own rule sets). See README.md, "Which build host, and why it matters".
note: Maximum allowed occurrences per warning code. Regenerate with warnings.ps1 -UpdateBaseline after an intentional change and record why in notes.<CODE> and the commit message. Codes listed in "untracked" are reported under "informational" instead and never fail the gate. These floors describe MP2-Frontend.sln: the two new projects (MediaPortal.Frontend, Tests.Frontend) plus every project they reference. Measured when this file was created, the two new projects contributed 0 findings of any code - the whole inventory belongs to the inherited closure (MediaPortal.Utilities, Common, Backend, Server.Api, UPnP), whose numbers are also gated by warning-baseline.json under the Server solution. What this file therefore protects is that the front end does not become the place where those codes grow again.
